# Borough agent instructions

Build a commercial business directory while satisfying the SoftUni capstone. Use only HTML, CSS, plain JavaScript, Bootstrap, npm, Node.js, Vite and Supabase. No React, Vue or TypeScript. Each screen has its own HTML file and page module. Keep services and reusable components separate.

All persistent application data belongs in Supabase. Use migrations for every database change; commit and verify remote migration history. Enforce authorization in PostgreSQL RLS and functions, never solely in UI. Never expose service-role keys in frontend code. Validate user input, escape rendered text, allow only safe URLs and validate file uploads. Moderation decisions and sensitive changes must be audited.

Review docs/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md before changes. Run relevant tests/build, fix failures, then commit and push meaningful changes. Keep truthful AI development notes; never manufacture commit dates or test outcomes. Preserve user changes. Document incomplete live verification.
